card.name: Digits inside numeric ranges
card.fires_on: Digits, decimal points and the word "to" inside a number range, usually after "range" or between two values such as "3.4 to 7.5". It fires partway through the number, before the range is complete.

modes.label: Decimal point in range
modes.description: The decimal point after the first digit of a number in a range or interval.

modes.label: Digit in a range value
modes.description: A digit within a multi-digit number that is part of a range or limit.
